data.title: 椎叶紬 · 橱窗前的发箍
data.description: 服装店外，紬把红色发箍举到眼前，比了比橱窗里的颜色。她已经在这里站了一会儿，仍没决定要不要买。
data.action: holding a hairband beside the shop window
data.promptProse: Standing beside a sunlit boutique display window on a shopping promenade, Tsumugi holds a red hairband up to her hair, checking her reflection in the glass with an amused smile. Autumn garments and potted topiaries frame the lively town backdrop.
